name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: The shape of content that is on its way.
use: Content whose layout is known before its data arrives: a card, a row, an avatar. Size each skeleton like the content it replaces, so the page does not jump when the content lands.

instead.when: The wait has no shape to show, as in a busy button or a region of unknown content
Words can say what is happening
The amount of work done is known

platform.fallback: Every skeleton in a block starts its band of light at the same moment

classes.name: skeleton
classes.description: A placeholder block; give it the height of the image, chart or card it stands for

classes.name: skeleton-text
classes.description: One line of text: as tall as the letters and centered in the line it stands for

classes.name: skeleton-circle
classes.description: A circle for an avatar or an icon, sized by its width
